name: RacoonTools
author: Sebastian Lind

sections.description:
The RacoonTools give you the possibility to configure WooCommerce with advanced settings right from the WordPress backend.

RacoonTools Plugin extends the WooCommerce plugin that makes advanced settings easy for your WooCommerce site.

The Plugin is compatible with classic themes such as the Twenty-twenty or the Storefront theme.
It is NOT compatible with block themes such as Twenty-twenty-five. In block themes you can use the site editor to adjust the templates.

The Plugin cannot be used standalone, WooCommerce has to be installed and activated first!

The functions in detail are:

  • General Settings
    • Set password strength (No review, Very easy, Easy, Medium, Strong, Very strong)
    • Set price suffix link text and target page
  • Breadcrumb
    • Show/Hide breadcrumb navigation
    • Customize breadcrumb home text
    • Customize breadcrumb home link
    • Customize breadcrumb separator
  • Shop Page
    • Set products per page
    • Hide result count
    • Hide category product count
    • Hide product order dropdown
    • Show quantities next to add to cart buttons
  • Single Product Page
    • Hide single product meta (SKU, category, tags)
    • Hide tab description
    • Hide tab reviews
    • Hide tab additional information
  • Checkout
    • Hide other shipping methods when free shipping is available (All or keep local pickup)
  • Checkout Fields
    • Remove Company Field
    • Make Phone Optional
  • Cart
    • Custom Empty Cart Text
    • Hide Shipping Calculator
  • Admin & Login
    • Custom Login Logo URL
    • Custom Admin Footer Text

RacoonTools requires at least:

  • WooCommerce Version 9.5.2 and later
  • WordPress 6.7.1 and later
sections.installation:
This section describes how to install the plugin and get it working.

  1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/racoontools directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Use the WooCommerce->Settings->RacoonTools Advanced Settings page to configure WooCommerce
sections.faq:
What requirements must be fulfilled?

WooCommerce has to be installed and activated first. RacoonTools requires at least WooCommerce Version 9.5.2 and later and WordPress 6.7.1 and later.

Which storefront theme version is compatible?

RacoonTools ist tested up until Storefront Version 4.6.2.
